ValidationRule.description: This validation will require a prequal date be present before an approval date can be entered. Does not apply to deals that were auto-declined and never entered the PreQual Stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( Type, "NEW"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "RENEWAL") ), ISBLANK(PreQual_Date__c), ISBLANK(Syndication_Date__c), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Approved - MCA" ), Record_Type_Name__c = 'Working Capital Oppty', $Setup.ValidationRules__c.Bypass_Opportunity_Stage_Validations__c = false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Prequal stage must be achieved prior to the approval stage.
